RECIPE: `runward init --yes`, add `runward/rules/zz-custom.md` with front matter `asi: [ASI11]`, run `runward compliance iso-42001`. Shipped build: exit 0, `ASI coverage 10/10 categories mapped to a rule`, pack written. Mutated: `asiCoverage.get("ASI11")` is undefined, the command aborts with `✗ Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')`, exit 1, and `runward/compliance/` is never created — no readiness draft, no OSCAL.
